name: Miller Research Fellowship
funder: Miller Institute for Basic Research in Science, UC Berkeley
amount: USD 95,000/year stipend (3% annual increase) + USD 10,000/year research fund + benefits and relocation
other_rules: Must be nominated by a faculty member, chair or research scientist (no self-nomination)
PhD received within the cycle window (2027-30 cycle: 1 Jan 2025 to 31 Aug 2027)
no more than 2 years of postdoc experience elsewhere by the start date
non-US citizens must qualify for J-1 status
notes: Basic sciences including molecular and cell biology. 2027-30 cycle: nominations 10 Sep 2026, applications 9 Oct 2026 (1-page research statement, CV, 3 references, Berkeley host letter). Results Dec 2026 to Feb 2027.
